record.one_liner: Brex offers a REST API for financial data and card management using bearer token authentication generated from the Brex dashboard.

auth_methods.quote: To pass your user token to Brex APIs, add it as a header to your API calls in the following format: Authorization: "Bearer {{your user_token here}}"

access_test.quote: Sign in to dashboard.brex.com as an account admin or card admin

access_ship.quote: If your company has not accepted the developer API agreement, please review the terms and conditions.

api_type.quote: Brex currently only offers a production API server at https://api.brex.com . This is the base URL for all API calls.

auth_methods.reason: The pages directly show that the user token is passed using the Bearer authorization header format.

access_test.reason: The provided pages explain how to generate a user token via the dashboard as an admin, but do not explicitly detail whether a developer can get credentials to test.

access_ship.reason: The text describes generating tokens and accepting developer agreements in the dashboard, but does not provide criteria for publishing or using an integration with real customers.

api_type.reason: The pages reference making API calls to the Brex API server at https://api.brex.com.
